name: Standing Alone
overview: Scripture reveals that standing alone is not a state of abandonment but an opportunity to rely fully on God's presence and strength. Even when forsaken by others, believers are assured that the Lord will uphold and gather them, as He promises to be with them, strengthen them, and never fail or forsake them. This confidence is rooted in God's shepherd-like care, His plans for peace and hope, and His faithful companionship in every circumstance.
